name: Andhra Pradesh BC Corporation Schemes (OBMMS)
teBrief: ఆంధ్రప్రదేశ్‌లో ఆన్‌లైన్ బెనిఫిషియరీ మేనేజ్‌మెంట్ & మానిటరింగ్ సిస్టమ్ (OBMMS) మరియు AP బీసీ కార్పొరేషన్ల ద్వారా నిర్వహించబడే వెనుకబడిన తరగతుల స్వయం ఉపాధి మరియు ఆర్థిక సహాయ పథకాలు.
agency: AP Backward Classes Cooperative Finance Corporation (APBCCFC)
brief: State Backward Classes welfare, self-employment and economic support programmes in Andhra Pradesh administered through the Online Beneficiary Management & Monitoring System (OBMMS) and AP BC Corporations.
briefFull: State Backward Classes welfare, self-employment and economic support programmes in Andhra Pradesh administered through the Online Beneficiary Management & Monitoring System (OBMMS) and AP BC Corporations.
details:
The Government of Andhra Pradesh administers Backward Classes economic support, self-employment and welfare programmes through the Andhra Pradesh Backward Classes Cooperative Finance Corporation (APBCCFC) and affiliated community corporations covering 138 recognised BC communities (BC-A, BC-B, BC-C, BC-D and BC-E).

Beneficiary registrations, bank-linked self-employment units and subsidy monitoring are typically routed through the state's Online Beneficiary Management & Monitoring System (OBMMS) and Grama/Ward Sachivalayam channels.
benefits:
- Bank-linked self-employment subsidy schemes, artisan and occupational support, and NBCFDC channelised concessional loans for eligible Backward Class beneficiaries in Andhra Pradesh.
- Specific scheme windows, unit ceilings and subsidy percentages are notified periodically by the Government of Andhra Pradesh BC Welfare Department.
eligibility:
1. Applicant must be a permanent resident of Andhra Pradesh belonging to a notified Backward Class community (BC-A, BC-B, BC-C, BC-D or BC-E).
2. Must hold a valid Andhra Pradesh Integrated Caste/Community Certificate and meet the annual income and age thresholds notified for the active scheme window.
howToApply:
1. Watch for active Andhra Pradesh BC Welfare Department / APBCCFC notifications.
2. Apply directly via the official Andhra Pradesh OBMMS portal or authorised Grama / Ward Sachivalayam centres.
3. Confirm scheme windows and bank-linkage guidelines directly with your District BC Welfare Office.
documentsRequired:
- Valid Andhra Pradesh BC Community Certificate
- Income Certificate / White Ration Card (as applicable)
- Aadhaar Card and active Bank Account linked with Aadhaar
- Enterprise unit quotation / project details (for self-employment schemes)

faqs.q: Which BC groups in Andhra Pradesh are covered under AP BC Corporations?
faqs.a: Andhra Pradesh recognises 138 Backward Class communities across five notified groups: BC-A, BC-B, BC-C, BC-D and BC-E.
